WITH group_averages AS (
  SELECT
    corpeventprx,
    AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount,
    AVG(inholdpct - instownpct) AS avg_ownership_gap
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY corpeventprx
),
all_event_gap AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ownership_gap) AS overall_avg_event_gap
  FROM group_averages
  WHERE corpeventprx IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  g.corpeventprx,
  g.avg_anlycount,
  g.avg_ownership_gap,
  g.avg_ownership_gap - a.overall_avg_event_gap AS gap_minus_overall_avg
FROM group_averages AS g
CROSS JOIN all_event_gap AS a
WHERE a.overall_avg_event_gap IS NOT NULL;
